comment: Ordered skin index. Combo n (0-based) owns ids 2n+1 (shaded) and 2n+2 (unshaded). Order is the index: appending a combo is safe, reordering/removing remaps existing ids. attachments names must match frontend/public/attachments/manifest.json (exported from godot/scenes/skin.tscn by godot/tools/export_attachments.gd). 'defaults' pins non-numeric skins (which are not part of the numeric index) to explicit combos.
